mapper.select: SELECT * FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, region, detail_address, is_default, label) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{region}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, #{label})
mapper.update: UPDATE address SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, region = #{region}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault}, label = #{label} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
